about: Where the build departs from the scroll map, and why (map/BUILDING.md). moves: positions (metres, X east, D north), applied by tools/map_layout.mjs on top of map/world/S4.json when it writes layout.json. how: an entity built differently from its kind's default (tools/loyalty_check.mjs). unbuilt: mapped entities not built yet, with the reason. edges: the walkable area's invisible walls. Sizes the strokes can't give are marked choice: in blender/outer_road_scene.py and listed in sections/outer_road/notes.md.

S4.prop.guardian_statue_9942.why: its base is estimated on the gate hall's front line; the statue is painted behind the lattice railing of the side bay, so it sits 0.6 m inside the front

S4.prop.guardian_statue_10102.why: as guardian_statue_9942: behind the east side bay's lattice railing

S4.ani.ox_far_10045.why: at real size (an ox is 0.72 m wide) it overlaps the shaft ox beside it: their painted centre lines are 0.56 m apart; it steps 0.2 m to its far (north) side, and S5's cart's yoke (gate_scene.py, from this layout) follows it

S4.ani.ox_shaft_10712.why: at real size its rump runs into the front corner of the second covered cart's body (the kit's 3.9 m body, 56% of it behind the painted wheel, ends 0.44 m past the painted front); it steps 0.8 m forward along its painted heading (48 deg), its harness with it (outer_road_scene.team applies the move to its hooves)

S4.grd.ditch_11570.why: the ditch's north bank is a painted construction (horizontal planks held by capped stakes: the raised forecourt's retaining face), built as a model; its dry bed and south bank are the ground surface

sides.what: invisible walls round the painted area, one per side (edge:south, edge:east, edge:north, edge:west; the world page drops a side that is a seam with a loaded neighbour): layout painted_area, the S5 seam at u 9400 (west), the inner seam at u 12600 (east), the silk's bottom and top edges
sides.why: outside the painted area the scroll paints nothing for this part of S4; the rest of S4 east of u 12600 is a later area
sides.beyond: painting, not models: mist (the scroll's blank silk) past the silk's bottom and top edges; the rest of S4 as a painted panel east (sections/outer_road/backdrop.json); the gate (S5) is built west
